fullContent:
Garbha Raksha Kashayam 
 Reference: Chikitsamanjari 
 Garbha Raksha Kashayam is an Ayurvedic herbal decoction for pregnancy care. As it is used in pregnancy, it should be taken only under strict medical supervision. It balances pitta and vata doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Punarnava – Boerhaavia diffusa 
 Draksha – Dry grapes – Vitis vinifera 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Yavani – Trachyspermum ammi 
 Bhadra – Aerva lanata 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 10 grams powder of each of herb is boiled in the 8 parts of water until reduces to quarter half. Garbha Raksha Kashayam is prepared. 
 Dosage 
 
 Take 5 – 10 ml, before food, or on empty stomach, once or twice a day or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is advised to add the equal amount of water in kashayam (decoction). 
 
 Indications 
 
 Used in pregnancy care of the mother. 
 Helps to relieve respiratory problems, gastritis and constipation problem of the expectant mother. 
 
 Side Effects 
 There are no known side effects of this medicine. Use it only under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
